notes.text:
Fix the original finite rational support X in one lattice vector space, all closed faces, strictly positive actual balanced top weights, and actual continuous printed-PC reference gamma. A printed legal split at y has rational child endpoints y_i, real alpha_i>=0 summing to1, y=sum alpha_i y_i, and a finite rational structure with faces tau<=sigma_i containing y and y_i respectively. The center may be real and tau need not be minimal. Each internal node of a finite tree retains its own witnessing structure; a common refinement is NOT assumed to preserve the witnessing incidence. Zero-weight branches may be deleted; repeated endpoints remain separate occurrences. A single real-root leaf is allowed. Let pi_a be the path product at a leaf. Leaf weights sum to1; cost_q(T)=sum pi_a q(y_a), q=gamma+u, |u|<=C.

Define F(x)=inf_T cost_q(T), over these finite legal trees at x. Repeated Jensen for gamma gives every cost >=gamma(x)-C, while the single-leaf tree gives F<=q<=gamma+C. For EVERY finite-valued raw printed-PC competitor f<=q with f<=gamma+C_f, repeated Jensen gives f(x)<=cost_q(T) for every tree. No lower bound, continuity or measurability of f is used. Consequently the actual upper-only supremum e<=F.

For any legal split at x, choose independently a finite tree at each positive-weight child with cost <F(x_i)+eta. There are finitely many children, so grafting gives F(x)<=sum alpha_i F(x_i)+eta. Let eta decrease to0. Thus F satisfies every printed PCC inequality on every permitted rational structure. It is finite, <=q, and <=gamma+C, so F itself is an original competitor. Hence F<=e and F=e. This reconstruction precedes any density, continuity or operator premise. It works even for merely bounded finite-valued u as an algebraic identity.

For continuous u apply the exact qualified R230 unrestricted-envelope theorem: finite rational embedded all-face positive-balanced support, continuous PC actual gamma and u in C_b are its hypotheses. It supplies continuity of this actual envelope and all real-endpoint PCC inequalities. It does NOT supply PA density. Infima over finite geometrically legal REAL-endpoint trees agree as well: the continuous endpoint is <=q and is bounded by every real-endpoint tree via its real Jensen inequalities, and printed trees form a subfamily. We retain the printed raw competitor convention rather than applying automatic raw-PC continuity.

Reference costs are retained exactly by the finite telescoping identity
sum_leaves pi_a gamma(y_a)-gamma(x)
=sum_internal pi_b(sum_children alpha_bi gamma(y_bi)-gamma(y_b)).
All terms on the right are nonnegative. A terminal barycenter identity alone is not legal-tree geometry and cannot replace it.

Positive actual recession on finite reference-affine cells implies gamma>=a||x||-b with a>0: write each cell as a finite point hull plus finite rational recession cone; choose a below the finitely many positive slope/ray-norm ratios and bound the point values, then use the triangle inequality. Nonzero lineality would violate positivity in one sign. Thus choose H=gamma+c>=0 proper. For a tree within eta of the u-envelope, its terminal finite probability nu satisfies integral H dnu<=H(x)+2C+eta, since its cost<=gamma(x)+C+eta and u>=-C. Therefore nu{H>R}<=(H(x)+2C+eta)/R. Evaluate the SAME legal tree with v, |v|<=C. Its cost changes by at most sup_{H<=R}|u-v|+2C nu{H>R}. Compare to the v infimum, let eta->0 and reverse u,v. This proves
|E_gamma(u)(x)-E_gamma(v)(x)|<=sup_{H<=R}|u-v|+2C(H(x)+2C)/R.
On compact root sets increase R and then pass bounded local-uniform obstacles to get local-uniform actual envelope convergence. The terminal probability is only a finite cost distribution, never MA. This also independently reconstructs the S282 tree-tail unit without importing any domain enlargement.

This is a mathematical proof relative to R230's precise continuity premise, not a finite-execution conclusion. Full proof and conventions are in P05.2-paper.tex Sections1,4,7 and argument.md. c_j(tau)=sum_{sigma facet-over tau} c_(j-1)(sigma)[a_sigma(n_sigma/tau)-a_tilde_tau(n_sigma/tau)].

For EVERY bounded genuine finite rational-carrier real-PA obstacle u (equivalently every bounded matching real affine tuple on every rational carrier), C=||u||, q=gamma+u, and EVERY real 0<epsilon<1, require a finite rational common carrier and actual real matching p plus finite support witnesses such that:
